summary: Finalized invoice shows exchange revaluation deficit applied to buffered batch credits
description: Issue summary: Customer received a finalized invoice dated 2026-03-01 with a negative adjustment line labeled 'exchange revaluation (estimated)' amounting to -$3,142. The line references buffered batch credits (kv-cache warmups / microbatch offsets). Customer believes credits were issued in USD but the adjustment uses a synthetic exchange spread that was not disclosed. Impact: BrightDesk AI reports a ~$3k unexpected reduction in credits on a finalized invoice, causing their finance team to flag the charge and pause automated payments. Environment: Production billing pipeline for org BrightDesk AI, enterprise tier, region us-east-1. Billing period: 2026-02-01 to 2026-02-28. Invoice ID: INV-2026-02-BD-1147.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer requested monthly invoice for Feb 2026. 2) Billing pipeline finalized invoice with hourly aggregates and applied postback reconciler. 3) Reconciliation job ran the month-end exchange revaluation step. 4) Finalized invoice includes adjustment line 'exchange revaluation (estimated)' attributed to buffered batch credits.
logs: Postback ledger entries: 987 rows mapped to invoice INV-2026-02-BD-1147
comments: 2026-03-10 09:12 - Maya Chen (BrightDesk AI): We noticed a negative adjustment labeled 'exchange revaluation (estimated)' on our finalized invoice for Feb. Can you explain why credits we received were reduced? This invoice is blocking our AP team.

2026-03-10 10:05 - Support (Maya Chen): Hi BrightDesk — thank you for reporting. I'm opening an investigation. Can you confirm whether your billing currency is USD and whether you recently changed your corporate billing currency in the console?

2026-03-10 11:30 - Customer (BrightDesk AI - Ahmed Patel): Confirmed billing currency is USD and no currency changes were made. We use reserved capacity plus hourly burst; credits applied are for kv-cache warmups during Feb batch jobs.
2026-03-11 14:22 - Support (Luca Romano): Assigned to billing/eng for investigation. Noted that month-end exchange revaluation runs at finalization. Tagging SRE billing: @sre-billing.

2026-03-12 08:41 - Engineering (Priya Shah): Initial hypothesis: month-end revaluation applied an FX spread from legacy aggregator when credits were created in a synthetic multi-currency reconciliation flow. We will validate ledger entries and fx snapshot used.

2026-03-13 16:05 - Support (Luca Romano): Partial update: Identified source ledger rows and reproduction steps. Engineering will compute a corrected revaluation and propose a provisional credit if calculation was in error.
investigation_notes: Mapped invoice INV-2026-02-BD-1147 to postback bucket br-postback-992. 987 ledger entries tied to buffered_batch credits (kv-cache warmups) between 2026-02-02 and 2026-02-27.

Postback timestamps spanned multiple UTC days; some credits were ingested by legacy aggregator that tags original_currency as 'USD' but stores internal nominal value in 'synthetic' currency for multi-region consolidation.

Exchange revaluation step used fx_table_snapshot_2026-03-01.csv created from FX service v1.1. Snapshot contains spread column 'applied_spread' set to 0.75% configured historically for consolidated ledgers; this spread should not apply to enterprise direct-billed customers.

Reconciler code path 'exchange_reval' branches: if ledger.origin == 'legacy_consolidator' then apply_spread=true else false. Several BrightDesk ledger rows have origin 'legacy_consolidator' due to an older integration from 2024 that was not backfilled.
Repro: running reconciler locally with corrected branch (force apply_spread=false) results in removal of the -$3,142 adjustment and produces parity with draft invoice before finalization.

Risk assessment: If we back out the adjustment retroactively, downstream tax rounding and invoice finalization will require a credit memo and reissue or a compensating credit in the next billing cycle.
resolution_notes: Root cause: Legacy consolidator origin flag erroneously persisted on a subset of postback ledger entries for BrightDesk AI. Month-end exchange revaluation applied a 0.75% spread configured for consolidated/multi-currency reconciliations; enterprise direct-billed customers should be excluded.

Short-term mitigation: Engineering prepared a corrected revaluation result (no spread) and generated a provisional credit file. Support approved issuing a one-time credit memo for INV-2026-02-BD-1147 in the amount of $3,142.00 to restore customer balance. Credit memo CM-2026-03-BD-77 created 2026-03-13.

Long-term fix: Create reconciler guardrail: treat origin == 'legacy_consolidator' as requiring explicit admin opt-in for spread application. Add a migration job to re-evaluate and re-tag historical ledger rows for enterprise orgs before month-end revaluation. Patch scheduled: billing-reconciler v2.4.1 deploy 2026-03-20 with unit/integration tests and a migration plan.

Customer communication: Notified BrightDesk AI of provisional credit and next steps; finance team confirmed acceptance and requested a brief write-up for their AP records. Support will follow up with final credit memo and Confluence note documenting the fix once deployment completes.

Follow-ups: (1) Run backfill to clear legacy_consolidator tag for BrightDesk historical rows; (2) Add monitoring alert when exchange revaluation spreads are applied to >0.1% of enterprise invoices; (3) Publish postmortem to Confluence after patch deployment.
